# Retained generator sources

GitAscii: https://github.com/Igorcbraz/GitAscii/tree/456d4cfaf6ee8a04724c0d17cf17206360f51e7e . The retained `gitascii/xmlUtils.ts` originates from `src/engine/core/xmlUtils.ts`; GPL-3.0-or-later license is included. Unused old renderers and converters were removed.

Profile Readme Generator: https://github.com/maurodesouza/profile-readme-generator/tree/10cf0a2f3bfb1672b23c7d4966673d184b26a4b4 . The actual technology parser is retained as `profile-readme-generator/techs.ts` under its included MIT license. Local types and icon paths are adapted; empty spacer images are replaced with nonbreaking spaces. The original source reference is in TECHS-SOURCE.md. Unused social parsers and assets were removed.

Portfolio Builder: https://github.com/PraveenKS30/portfolio-builder-skill was used during design review for truthful copy, source extraction and the visual direction. It is not a runtime dependency.

The current portrait and closed in-grid snake use local source scripts; neither needs the retired downloaded comparison tools or a separate snake action.
